title: Astral War
brief: A browser-based FPS inspired by CoD: World at War, built in a day with GPT-6 Astra Ultra — a remix/upgrade of Modern Claudefare, named in the announcement tweet.
details: Astral War is a free, fan-made World War II-themed first-person shooter that runs entirely in a browser tab with no download, built on Three.js. It offers Team Deathmatch and Free-for-All across three maps, playable against bots or in 12-player online matches with voice chat. It is desktop-only — a keyboard and mouse or a controller is required to play. The site is made by Vesper and positions itself as the frontline-is-on-desktop browser shooter with fast load-in and no install friction.
